# Steel Wool Hair

Wix-managed Astro clean-URL website for the **existing** Steel Wool Hair Wix Headless site.

Existing Wix site ID: `3a1fe884-069e-4cfb-a76b-de7403733eed`.

Published main pages: `/`, `/hair-menu`, `/contact`, `/privacy-policy`, `/terms-of-use`. Every page has a `.astro` registration under `src/pages/`, rendering the existing corresponding `src/content/*.html` content.

**Sitemap is generated by Wix**, not by a custom file or endpoint:
- `https://www.steelwoolhair.com.au/sitemap.xml` (sitemap index)
- `https://www.steelwoolhair.com.au/pages-sitemap.xml` (all 5 pages)
- `https://www.steelwoolhair.com.au/robots.txt` (Wix-managed)

All three were externally verified HTTP 200 on 6 November 2026.

**Standard headless site procedure:** [docs/headless-launch-checklist.md](docs/headless-launch-checklist.md). Every headless site must have Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, Wix-generated XML sitemap, footer links to both policies, and an external XML/site-registry verification.

Do not provision a new Wix site or replace the existing frontend with a static upload. Preserve the existing site content and Wix Forms integration.
